AutoTap lets you use the volume keys to perform deterministic taps at two positions you choose.
AutoTap
Enable AutoTap

Requires Accessibility permission. Volume Up starts tapping and Volume Down stops. The status indicator and two target circles are only for display and dragging; tapping or double-tapping them never starts AutoTap. When AutoTap is disabled, the volume keys control system volume normally.

Drag the two target circles onto the positions you want to tap. Volume Up starts and Volume Down stops. The status indicator and both targets can be dragged and remember their previous positions; tapping or double-tapping them never starts or stops AutoTap.
Tap interval (ms)
Default: 40 ms
Tap duration (seconds)
Default: 60 seconds

The system temporarily refused to show the AutoTap targets. Check the permission to display over other apps. If your device has no such switch, reopen Nova Calculator in Accessibility settings and tap Retry now.
The system window token is temporarily unavailable. Tap Retry now first. If it still fails, turn Nova Calculator Accessibility off and on again, then restart the device if needed.
The current display area is temporarily unavailable. Exit split screen, casting, or other floating tools, return to the main screen, and tap Retry now. If needed, reopen the Accessibility service.
AutoTap encountered a temporary system error. Try Retry now, reopen the Accessibility service, force stop and reopen the app, then restart the device. You can copy diagnostics for troubleshooting.
Enable Nova Calculator in system Accessibility settings, then return and tap Retry now. The targets will be restored automatically.
The AutoTap service has not finished initializing. Tap Retry now. If the problem continues, turn Nova Calculator Accessibility off and on again, then restart the device if needed.

Accessibility is connected, but the AutoTap targets are not visible yet. Tap Retry now. If they still do not appear, exit split screen/casting/other floating tools, reopen Accessibility, and restart the device. Some devices may also require background activity permission.
